name: Gamepad
description: Gamepad API - poll connected controllers, inspect buttons and axes, receive connection events, and control haptics.

reviewedExclusions.rationale: Direct function-valued event-handler property assignment has no independent callback-registration lifetime. The profile preserves this event through the typed WindowEventMap subscription surface and its owned async-disposable registration.
